claims.evidence: Witness photos show a Yamaha-branded black keyboard with a large YAMAHA logo, but the report does not show the exact model/specs that would confirm it is a 'professional' class keyboard.

risks.risk: Exact model/spec is unknown; pricing depends heavily on whether it’s an entry-level vs mid/pro workstation (keys count, polyphony, built-in sounds, features).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model name/number label (usually on the back panel or underside) and/or the screen showing the model during boot.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case for an unverified Yamaha keyboard (assume basic/unknown model and treat as untested).

risks.risk: Functionality is unverified (may not power on, no sound, dead keys, faulty speakers/volume, or non-working buttons).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing power-on, volume change, at least one demo/voice, and pressing several keys across the range with audible output.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/untested until a working demo is shown.

risks.risk: Physical condition is unverified (missing/stuck keys, cracks, damaged stand, worn/pitted buttons).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all keys (especially ends), the stand joints, and the control panel surface; plus a clip showing keys return properly (no sticking).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming possible wear/damage consistent with used electronics without confirmed condition.

risks.risk: Accessories and power adapter/charger may be missing or mismatched (keyboard won’t function without the correct adapter).
risks.proof: Photo of the included power adapter/charger label (voltage/amp) and a clip plugging it in and powering the keyboard.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming adapter may be missing or not guaranteed.

risks.risk: Connectivity/accessories (headphone jack, USB/MIDI, sustain pedal, mic input) may be faulty or missing, affecting usability and value.
risks.proof: Photos of all ports and included pedals/cables; a clip testing headphone output and (if present) sustain pedal response.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming limited accessories and unverified port functionality.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the keyboard’s model name/number label (back/underside) so we can price the correct Yamaha series.
Send a short video: power-on + audible demo/voice + volume up/down + pressing keys across the full keyboard range.
Send close-ups of the entire keybed (including both ends) and the stand joints to confirm no missing/stuck keys or cracks.
Confirm whether the correct power adapter/charger is included; send a photo of its label and a clip showing it powering the keyboard.
Show photos of all ports (headphone/USB/MIDI/sustain etc.) and any included sustain pedal/cables; test at least one port in a short clip.
response.reason: The witness confirms Yamaha branding and a keyboard form factor, but the exact model and working condition are not readable/verified in the report. Without a working demo and model identification, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
